quote: It shall be unlawful for any person driving or operating, propelling or causing to be propelled, any vehicle, to fail to stop not less than fifty feet from the nearest side of a school pedestrian lane where any signal device, flagman or other person is stationed, giving warning that children are about to cross or are crossing the street; and it is further declared unlawful to proceed until such signal has stopped, raised, or been removed, or the flagman or person stationed at such pedestrian lane has given a signal to go, or has left the locality.

activation.source_clause: where any signal device, flagman or other person is stationed, giving warning that children are about to cross or are crossing the street
activation.description: Observe a stationed warning actor, school pedestrian lane and child-crossing warning context.

obligation.source_clause: to fail to stop not less than fifty feet from the nearest side of a school pedestrian lane
obligation.description: Retain original front, centre and rear stop distances from the source-surveyed nearest lane side; reserve the legal reference-point judgment.
